social-9f2f4b0dc02c.text: NEW CLIP #2: #Bears DB coach/ Def. Pass Game Coordinator Al Harris on if he feels #Cowboys owner Jerry Jones presumably seeing Harris' value even more in his absence with the #Bears , helped paved the path for new Dallas defensive coordinator Christian Parker: "First let me say I am rooting for C.P. (Christian Parker). I hope he does an excellent job, but for whatever reason, that is his opportunity. That was for him. So I have no ill will towards anybody In Dallas. They just did not see it in the cards. Realistically, you want to be where you are wanted. So, if I wasn’t wanted there, then hey, I know I am wanted here; and just see what God has in store for me.” On not getting the defensive coordinator promotion in Dallas in 2024. Former Cowboys head coach Mike McCarthy hired Mike Zimmer for the role after Dan Quinn got the HC job with the #Commanders : “I truly believe this to my core, that what is for me nobody can stop (God); no coach, nobody. So the fact that it didn’t happen there, that means I was meant to be here (Chicago) in this role. So, I constantly think of it that way; that just keeps you from getting down in the dumps because you may think you deserve this opportunity, but God may not want you to have that opportunity just yet….So, the conversations, they weren’t real conversations. I knew after that last year that Mike (Zimmer) wasn’t going to be back in Dallas. It was time for me to leave Dallas. God, put it in my heart, and you know once I talked to Ben (Johnson) I was all in on coming here to Chicago.” On if Harris (51) had initial frustrations at delayed chances to be a defensive coordinator or head coach, given all his accomplishments & as other position coaches ascended to the top spots faster: “Initially of course you are bummed out, but…I just lean in on what’s for me is for me. At some point there will be someone who will say ‘hey look, man this guy is getting this done everywhere, every stop he makes,’ and will take a chance. So I truly believe at what I do, nothing against any other coach or anything like that at what I do; I am the best in the world at what I do.” FULL INTERVIEW: Subscribe Support Independent Media: YT: @ExhibitNEWSNetwork
social-9f2f4b0dc02c.author: Josina Anderson
